question: Does the frozen P0599 bounded potential-shape law interpolate through the SPARC-CLASH potential gap on independent BCG dynamics, and which incomplete host-baryon assumption matters most?

primary.reason: measured median hot-gas host potential, extended-cluster radial shape, and low-acceleration host screening are the closest available proxies to the P0599 full baryon-system quantities

claim_limits: Eleven BCG accelerations are direct Tian et al. measurements; the remaining 23 are disjointly calibrated MaNGA DynPop/NSA proxies.
The SPIDERS hosts lack resolved baryon profiles, so potential, radial shape, and source acceleration are bracketed rather than measured together.
The CLASH median radial shape is an environment proxy, not a per-BCG measurement.
The formula constants were selected on disclosed SPARC and CLASH data; P0600 is an external bridge test only with respect to BCG values.
